lines.text: Two lines cross in a triangle of area sixty.
lines.caption: Two lines cross in a triangle of area sixty.

lines.text: How big is the shaded piece? Half is tempting!
lines.caption: How big is the shaded piece? Half is tempting!

lines.text: D is the midpoint of B C. E splits A C, two to one.
lines.caption: D is the midpoint of B C. E splits A C, two to one.

lines.text: A D and B E cross at P. What's the area of A B P?
lines.caption: A D and B E cross at P. What's the area of A B P?

lines.text: Triangle A B D is half of sixty. That's thirty.
lines.caption: Triangle A B D is half of sixty. That's thirty.

lines.text: Draw D F, parallel to B E. F is the midpoint of E C.
lines.caption: Draw D F, parallel to B E. F is the midpoint of E C.

lines.text: Four steps, one, one. So A P to P D is four to one.
lines.caption: Four steps, one, one. So A P to P D is four to one.

lines.text: That makes A B P four fifths of A B D.
lines.caption: That makes A B P four fifths of A B D.

lines.text: Four fifths of thirty is twenty-four!
lines.caption: Four fifths of thirty is twenty-four!

lines.text: Every line gets its own ratio.
lines.caption: Every line gets its own ratio.
